timer_toggle_auto_start_work_desc: Automatically begin the next work session after a break ends.
timer_toggle_auto_start_break_desc: Automatically begin a break when a work session ends.
timer_toggle_short_breaks_desc: Skip the short break between work rounds.
timer_toggle_long_breaks_desc: Skip the long break at the end of each cycle.
timer_toggle_countdown_desc: Arc starts full and subtracts as time passes.
notif_toggle_desktop_desc: Show a system notification when each round ends.
notif_toggle_tick_work_desc: Play a ticking sound during work sessions.
notif_toggle_tick_break_desc: Play a ticking sound during break sessions.
system_toggle_aot_desc: Keep the timer window above all other windows.
system_toggle_break_aot_desc: Disable always-on-top while a break is running.
system_toggle_show_tray_desc: Display a persistent icon in the system tray.
system_tray_gnome_hint: On GNOME, tray icons require the AppIndicator extension. Install it with your package manager (e.g. gnome-shell-extension-appindicator) or from extensions.gnome.org, then log out and back in.
system_toggle_min_tray_desc: Hide the window to the tray when minimized.
system_toggle_close_tray_desc: Hide to the tray instead of quitting when the window is closed.
system_toggle_websocket_desc: Expose a local WebSocket endpoint for external integrations (port {port}).
system_toggle_check_updates_desc: Automatically check for new versions when Settings is opened.
shortcuts_accessibility_notice: Global shortcuts require Accessibility access on macOS. Enable Pomotroid in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility.
shortcuts_note: Global shortcuts work even when the window is not focused. Click a field and press your desired key combination to record it.
shortcuts_toggle_enabled_desc: Register system-wide keyboard shortcuts for controlling the timer.
shortcuts_local_note: Active while the app window is focused. Click a field and press a key to rebind.
advanced_toggle_verbose_logging_desc: Enable detailed debug logging to help diagnose issues.
about_reset_confirm: This will reset all settings to defaults.
stats_empty_history: Complete your first session to see your history
notification_work_body: Time to get back to work. You've got this!
notification_work_start_body: Time to focus. You've got this!
notification_short_break_body: Take a short break. Stretch, breathe, relax.
notification_long_break_body: You've earned a long break. Step away and recharge.
tooltip_restart_round: Restart the current round from the beginning.
tooltip_reset: Reset the timer to the first work round. Current session progress will be cleared.
tooltip_round_counter: Current work round out of the total rounds before a long break.
tooltip_round_counter_session: Continuous session round count. Resets only when the timer is reset.
tooltip_verbose_logging: Enables detailed debug logging. Use when reporting issues. Log files are accessible via Open Log Folder in Settings → About.
tooltip_dial_countdown: When enabled, the progress arc counts down to zero instead of filling up.
tooltip_auto_start_work: Automatically start the next work round when a break ends.
tooltip_auto_start_break: Automatically start the break when a work round completes.
tooltip_websocket: Enables a local WebSocket server for external integrations such as stream overlays. Disabled by default.
stats_active_average_hint: Based on days with completed Pomodoros
stats_week_chart_help: Last seven days. Left and right arrows move by day; Enter or Space pins details; Escape clears selection.
stats_week_empty: No completed sessions in the last 7 days
stats_detail_hint: Hover to preview a date; click to pin details
stats_year_chart_help: Activity in {year}. Left and right arrows move by week; up and down move by day; Enter or Space pins details; Escape clears selection.
stats_load_error: Could not load statistics. Previous results are retained when available.
mini_open_error: Could not open or restore the mini window. The main window is retained; please try again.
stats_start_hour_help: Grouped by start hour: only completed work sessions are counted. Their full duration is attributed to the starting hour.
stats_hour_chart_help: Today by hour. Left/right moves between hours; Enter or Space pins details; Escape clears selection.
stats_hour_detail_hint: Hover to preview an hour; click to pin details
plan_duplicate_name: A plan with this name already exists.
plan_invalid_config: Durations must be 1–90 minutes (seconds allowed), with 1–12 rounds.
plan_last: The last plan cannot be deleted.
plan_in_use: Switch plans or cancel the next-round arrangement before deleting a plan in use.
plan_missing: This plan no longer exists. Select another plan.
plan_error: The operation failed. Please try again.
plan_stale_round: The round or arrangement has changed. Please check the current state and try again.
plan_apply_now: Apply now and start a new focus round…
plan_apply_confirm: The current round will end without being completed. A new focus round will start using the new plan.
plan_delete_confirm: Delete “{name}”? Session history will be retained.
round_stopped_body: Stopped as arranged. The next round is ready; start it when you are ready.
round_changed: The round changed; reopen this menu
category_empty: No categories yet. New focus rounds are uncategorized by default.
category_duplicate_name: This name is already used by an active or archived category.
category_reserved_name: “Uncategorized” is a system label. Choose a different name.
category_archived_error: Archived categories cannot be assigned to new focus rounds.
category_invalid_action: This category operation is not available.
category_stale_round: The round has changed. Check the current category and try again.
category_error: Could not load or update categories. Please try again.
category_pending: Use “{name}” for the next focus round
category_archive_fallback: “{name}” was archived; future focus rounds are uncategorized.
category_no_active: No active categories. Create one or restore an archived category.
detail_time_help: Start and end times may include pauses. Accumulated focus uses the duration of completed work sessions.
detail_empty: No matching work records for this day.
detail_load_error: Could not load records or current session status. Please try again.
detail_invalid_limit: Page size must be between 1 and 100.
detail_invalid_cursor: The record range changed. Reload this day.
category_next_hint: Changes apply to the next focus round
tray_disabled_note: Applies when the tray is enabled
data_package_hint: Save this app's history, categories and saved timer profiles for later import.
data_reports_hint: Export daily summaries or work sessions within a selected range.
data_export_notes: Includes completed, incomplete and break records. Does not save the current countdown, one-time arrangements, window positions or local paths. Save any unfinished profile edits in profile management first.
data_private: This unencrypted file contains personal history. Keep it safe.
data_external_themes: Only bundled theme selections can travel with the package. Custom themes and external resources are not included.
data_timezone_hint: Original instants stay unchanged. Dates are displayed and grouped in this computer's local time zone.
data_duplicates: {count} identical duplicates within the file were consolidated; they are not counted as additions.
data_keep_local: Identical data is skipped; content conflicts keep the local version. Existing local records will not be deleted.
data_rename_hint: These names are for new imported items; existing local items are not renamed.
data_category_conflict_hint: New sessions referencing a conflicting category identity use the local category's retained name and archive status.
data_active_round: Please end the current round before importing data.
data_no_changes: These data already exist. Nothing needs importing.
data_only_conflicts: All conflicting items will keep their local versions. No data needs writing.
data_reconfirm: Local data has changed. Review the updated preview and confirm again.
data_imported: Added {added} records, skipped {existing} identical records, kept {conflicts} local conflicts.
data_importing: Importing… Final commit cannot be cancelled.
data_refresh_failed: Data was imported, but refreshing the interface failed. Reopen the statistics window.
data_last_failed: The file was saved, but the last export time could not be recorded.
data_error: The operation failed. Please try again.
data_format: Unsupported format. Choose a data package exported by this version of Pomotroid.
data_version: Unsupported data format version. This app supports format version 1.
data_corrupt: The file is damaged or is not valid UTF-8 JSON.
data_invalid: Invalid data fields, values, or resource limits.
data_too_large: The data package exceeds the 64 MiB limit. No records were omitted or written.
data_reference: A session refers to a category missing from the file. Import is blocked.
data_internal_conflict: The file contains different content for the same stable identity. Import is blocked.
data_preferences_invalid: The display preferences include an unsupported value or theme.
data_expired: This preview was cancelled or expired. Choose the file again.
data_read_failed: Could not read the selected file.
data_save_failed: Could not save the file. The existing target was preserved.
data_protected_path: This location is protected application data or an active import source. Choose another file.
data_suffix: Keep the extension shown in the save dialog and try again.
data_rolled_back: Database writing failed. The entire import transaction was rolled back; nothing was imported.
report_hour_cleared: The date range changed; the previous hour restriction was removed.
report_hour_type: With an hour restriction, only session details are available.
report_empty: No records in this range. The CSV will contain only its header.
report_invalid_scope: Check the date range, category and hour selection.
report_local_zone: Dates include the end day and use this computer's local time zone ({zone}).
report_formula_note: CSV is a report. Risky text is prefixed with a tab for Excel; re-saving in other spreadsheet apps may change it. Use a data package to preserve original text.
distribution_empty: No completed focus records in this range.
